en-US.name: Home Pantry
en-US.summary: Check what's in your fridge, freezer and pantry, and manage your shopping list by voice.
en-US.description: Home Pantry connects to your household's own Home Inventory app. Ask what you have in stock, add or remove items from your shopping list, log what you bought or used, and turn a planned menu into a shopping list for whatever you're missing.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask shopping assistant what's on my shopping list
Alexa, tell shopping assistant to add milk to my shopping list
Alexa, ask shopping assistant how much chicken I have

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Requires the companion Home Inventory server to be running and reachable at the URL configured in the Lambda's API_BASE_URL environment variable. See home-inventory/alexa-skill/README.md.
